module

public import Mathlib.Algebra.Order.Archimedean.Real.Basic
public import Mathlib.Combinatorics.SimpleGraph.Acyclic

@[expose] public section

namespace SimpleGraph
variable {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]

open Finset List

/-- `Ls G` is the maximum number of leaves over all spanning trees of `G`.
It is defined to be `0` when `G` is not connected. -/
noncomputable def Ls (G : SimpleGraph α) [DecidableRel G.Adj] : ℝ :=
  open scoped Classical in
  letI spanningTrees := { T : Subgraph G | T.IsSpanning ∧ IsTree T.coe }
  letI leaves (T : Subgraph G) := T.verts.toFinset.filter (fun v => T.degree v = 1)
  letI num_leaves (T : Subgraph G) := (leaves T).card
  sSup (Set.image (fun T => (num_leaves T : ℝ)) spanningTrees)


end SimpleGraph

reformulations.difference: The source describes an integer maximum of spanning-tree leaf counts; Lean takes a supremum in ℝ and obtains the disconnected-graph value through the empty-supremum convention rather than an explicit conditional.
reformulations.equivalence_argument: Subgraph.IsSpanning requires every ambient vertex, and IsTree T.coe requires the resulting subgraph to be connected and acyclic. Subgraph degrees agree with degrees in the coerced graph, so the filtered cardinality counts exactly its degree-one vertices. Every count lies between 0 and Fintype.card α, making the set of possible counts finite. This set is nonempty exactly when G is connected, and its real supremum is then an attained maximum. Otherwise it is empty and Real.sSup_empty gives 0, as documented. In /workspace/review/scratch.lean, Review.Ls_characterization proves the explicit ↔ between Ls G = r and attainment together with the upper-bound property for all spanning trees; Review.Ls_disconnected proves the empty-case value.

review.notes: Checked the file's sole declaration and all nine problem use sites. Each use site uses the same maximum-leaf invariant and assumes a finite, connected, nontrivial graph. No Mathlib duplicate was found. The scratch file compiles without errors or warnings and contains no sorry; it proves the maximum characterization, 0 ≤ Ls G ≤ |V|, the disconnected and subsingleton cases, and values Ls(K₂)=2, Ls(P₃)=2 and Ls(K₁,₃)=3, alongside computable degree/leaf-count checks. Live WOWII URLs timed out, so the archived primary pages were used. Their older open labels for conjectures 2 and 217 were not treated as contradicting later proof metadata; the cited arXiv paper independently confirms the solution of conjecture 2. All review-created files are under /workspace/review/.
